abstract_title: The Rigged Hilbert Space:  A Formalism for Continuous Orch OR as the Flow State
abstract: The Rigged Hilbert Space (RHS) provides a rigorous mathematical foundation for modeling consciousness as a continuous form of Orchestrated Objective Reduction (Orch OR) during the Flow State. Within this framework, transitions into the flow state correspond to measurable reorganizations in fine-scale resonance dynamics—most prominently expressed through a Triplet-of-Triplets hierarchy—whose emergent eigenvalue structure exhibits properties consistent with the Hilbert–Pólya conjecture.
